people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: So that the law has become our tutor to bring us to Christ, that we might be justified by faith.
translations.bsb: So the law became our guardian to lead us to Christ, that we might be justified by faith.
translations.kjv: Wherefore the law was our schoolmaster to bring us unto Christ, that we might be justified by faith.
translations.asv: So that the law is become our tutor to bring us unto Christ, that we might be justified by faith.
